exclusions.reason: Showroom/UGC seeding order: manual fixed-amount discount with no customer.

ad_spend.label: Ad spend
ad_spend.treatment: Billed spend. The one platform figure allowed into Shopify-denominated ratios, because it is money paid, not a platform claim. At product grain: spend on ads promoting the product.

ad_status_coverage.label: Ad status coverage
ad_status_coverage.formula: ads with delivery in the period whose effective_status is known ÷ ads with delivery
ad_status_coverage.treatment: Without status, exposure counts include paused and archived ads.

alert_egp_at_stake.label: EGP at stake in open alerts
alert_egp_at_stake.formula: Σ EGP at stake across open performance alerts; each alert computes its own

aov.label: AOV
aov.formula: Σ order total ÷ orders, non-excluded orders created in the period

assisted_channel_share.label: Assisted channel share
assisted_channel_share.formula: conversions with a non-last-click channel in the path ÷ conversions

attributed_net_sales.label: Attributed net sales
attributed_net_sales.formula: net_sales_attributed of orders attributed to the entity

attributed_orders.label: Attributed orders
attributed_orders.formula: Shopify orders whose attributed_ad_id resolves to the entity (click id or UTM)

attribution_coverage.label: Attribution coverage
attribution_coverage.formula: orders carrying a click id or UTM ad id ÷ orders

blended_mer.label: Blended MER
blended_mer.treatment: Always rendered beside delivered_mer, with mer_gap as its own figure.

branded_search_clicks.label: Branded search
branded_search_clicks.treatment: No source connected (Search Console). Missing until one is.

bundle_attach_rate.label: Bundle attach rate
bundle_attach_rate.formula: orders containing a bundle line ÷ orders

cod_collection_fees.label: COD collection fees
cod_collection_fees.formula: COD fee rate × collected value on delivered COD orders
cod_collection_fees.treatment: Charged on collected value only. The fee rate is a stated assumption until confirmed against courier statements.

cogs_coverage_rate.label: COGS coverage
cogs_coverage_rate.formula: delivered units with a unit_cogs_snapshot ÷ delivered units

cogs_delivered.label: COGS on delivered units
cogs_delivered.formula: Σ unit_cogs_snapshot × quantity on lines of delivered orders
cogs_delivered.treatment: Cancelled units are not charged COGS where the stock is restocked — charging it double-counts. Where stock is not recovered it is charged. Units with no COGS snapshot are left out and reported through cogs_coverage_rate (partial state).

continuity_open_flags.label: Open continuity flags
continuity_open_flags.formula: open rows in metric_continuity_flags with break_date on or before period end

contribution_cac_ratio.label: Contribution ÷ CAC
contribution_cac_ratio.treatment: Below 1 means incremental orders lose money — the most important threshold in the system; it must be impossible to miss.

contribution_margin.label: Contribution margin
contribution_margin.formula: gross_profit − ad_spend − fulfilment_cost_outbound − cod_collection_fees − rto_shipping_waste − refund_value + returned goods COGS
contribution_margin.treatment: Modelled while any component is modelled (freight, COD fees). Refunds leave net of the fees the customer pays, and returned stock is credited back at what it cost, because it goes back on the shelf. A returned unit with no cost on file cannot be credited and reads slightly pessimistic. The objective function (§0): delivered contribution margin per drop.

courier_sla_days.label: Courier SLA
courier_sla_days.formula: median days from first fulfilment to delivery

creative_tagging_coverage.label: Tagging coverage
creative_tagging_coverage.formula: spend on ads with angle, hook_type, format, creator, offer, concept and promoted product all set ÷ ad_spend
creative_tagging_coverage.treatment: An untagged share is a state, not a silent omission.

cumulative_net_sales_since_drop.label: Net sales since drop
cumulative_net_sales_since_drop.formula: net_sales_attributed from drop_date through period end

cumulative_orders_since_drop.label: Orders since drop
cumulative_orders_since_drop.formula: non-excluded orders created from drop_date through period end

days_since_drop.label: Days since drop
days_since_drop.formula: period end − drop_date of the drop in effect (launch day = 0)
days_since_drop.treatment: Counts from drop_date. The legacy weekly Sheets field counts from drop_week_start; they are different measures and must not be compared.

days_to_next_drop.label: Days to next drop
days_to_next_drop.formula: next drop_date recorded in dim_drop − period end; missing when no next drop is recorded

decay_rate.label: Decay rate
decay_rate.formula: fitted daily decay of net sales after drop day 0

decision_center_egp_at_stake.label: EGP at stake, decision center
decision_center_egp_at_stake.formula: Σ EGP at stake across open decision-center items

decisions_due_for_review.label: Decisions due for review
decisions_due_for_review.formula: decisions past review_date with no actual_result

decisions_logged.label: Decisions logged
decisions_logged.formula: decision_log rows decided in the period

delivered_orders.label: Delivered orders
delivered_orders.formula: non-excluded orders created in the period whose delivery_status is delivered

delivered_revenue.label: Delivered revenue
delivered_revenue.formula: Σ (total − shipping_charged − tax) over delivered orders created in the period
delivered_revenue.treatment: Right-censored: orders in transit are not delivered yet; coverage states the resolved share.

direct_sessions_ga4.label: Direct sessions
direct_sessions_ga4.formula: GA4 sessions with channel group Direct

direct_sessions_shopify.label: Direct sessions
direct_sessions_shopify.formula: Σ Shopify sessions whose referrer bucket is direct
direct_sessions_shopify.treatment: Shopify's own referrer bucket, not a GA4 channel group. `social` counts paid and organic social together, so it is traffic from social, not organic demand on its own. Direct also catches sessions that arrive with no referrer at all, which includes in-app browsers, so it is a ceiling on people who came looking for the brand.

discount_depth_realised.label: Discount depth (realised)
discount_depth_realised.formula: discounts ÷ gross_sales on lines the offer touched

discounted_revenue.label: Discounted revenue
discounted_revenue.formula: net sales of lines sold with any discount

discounts.label: Discounts
discounts.formula: Σ discount_total (line discounts at merchandise grains), non-excluded orders created in the period

drop_lift.label: Drop lift
drop_lift.formula: net sales over drop days 0–6 ÷ net sales over the 7 days before drop_date

exchange_orders.label: Exchanged orders
exchange_orders.formula: orders with an exchange requested in the period

exchange_rate.label: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.formula: orders with an exchange ÷ delivered orders

exchange_request_rate_units.label: Exchange request rate (units)
exchange_request_rate_units.formula: units asked to exchange ÷ units sold, both by the order's own date
exchange_request_rate_units.treatment: Kept apart from returns on purpose: an exchange keeps the revenue and costs a second shipment. Requests arrive 1-9 days after the order (measured over the first export: 94% within 7 days), so a week is only fully readable 14 days after it ends; coverage states the settled share. Orders placed before the first uploaded request file have no request data at all and read missing, never 0.

exchange_requests_units.label: Units asked to exchange
exchange_requests_units.formula: units on Yanet exchange requests, counted against the week the order was placed
exchange_requests_units.treatment: Requests arrive 1-9 days after the order (measured over the first export: 94% within 7 days), so a week is only fully readable 14 days after it ends; coverage states the settled share. Orders placed before the first uploaded request file have no request data at all and read missing, never 0.

exchange_size_swap_share.label: Size-only exchanges
exchange_size_swap_share.formula: exchanges where only the size changed ÷ exchanges
exchange_size_swap_share.treatment: A fit signal: returns and exchanges by size surface fit problems that otherwise read as quality problems.

exclusion_orders_removed.label: Orders excluded
exclusion_orders_removed.formula: orders created in the period with exclusion_rule set
exclusion_orders_removed.treatment: Exclusions apply at the fact level over their full history and report what they removed.

exclusion_units_removed.label: Units excluded
exclusion_units_removed.formula: Σ units_total of orders created in the period with exclusion_rule set

exclusion_value_removed.label: Order value excluded
exclusion_value_removed.formula: Σ total of orders created in the period with exclusion_rule set

forecasts_logged_before_drop.label: Forecasts logged before drop
forecasts_logged_before_drop.formula: forecast_log rows for the drop produced before drop_date

fulfilment_cost_outbound.label: Fulfilment (outbound)
fulfilment_cost_outbound.formula: courier rate by zone × shipped orders that were not returned; a returned parcel's outbound and return legs are in rto_shipping_waste
fulfilment_cost_outbound.treatment: Modelled from the founder's rate card (Cairo/Giza 75, Delta 85, rest of Egypt 150) until courier invoices are loaded. An order with no province code is unpriced and counts against coverage.

full_price_revenue.label: Full-price revenue
full_price_revenue.formula: net sales of lines sold at full price

funnel_largest_loss_egp.label: Largest single funnel loss
funnel_largest_loss_egp.formula: EGP value of the rung with the largest drop-off against the store's own distribution

ga4_other_row_share.label: GA4 (other) row share
ga4_other_row_share.formula: sessions in GA4 cardinality-truncation (other) rows ÷ sessions
ga4_other_row_share.treatment: Truncation rows surface as such rather than silently distorting a segment.

gross_sales.label: Gross sales
gross_sales.formula: Σ unit_price × quantity before discounts, non-excluded orders created in the period

incrementality_proxy.label: Incrementality proxy
incrementality_proxy.formula: net sales at constant spend, drop-day normalised

instagram_engagement_rate.label: Instagram engagement rate
instagram_engagement_rate.treatment: No source connected. Missing until one is.

instagram_follower_growth.label: Instagram follower growth
instagram_follower_growth.formula: followers at period end − followers at period start
instagram_follower_growth.treatment: No source connected. Missing until one is.

inventory_depletion_pace.label: Inventory depletion pace
inventory_depletion_pace.formula: committed units sold by the drop-day ÷ units committed
inventory_depletion_pace.treatment: Renders beside revenue pace: a drop can beat revenue forecast while destroying the size curve.

land_rate.label: Land rate
land_rate.treatment: Stated on link clicks, which is what landing page views are counted against. Ad rows written before 2026-09-16 have no link clicks and read missing rather than wrong.

low_cover_paid_spend.label: Paid spend on low-cover products
low_cover_paid_spend.formula: ad spend on ads promoting a product whose days_of_cover is below the store's own low-cover percentile

net_sales_attributed.label: Net sales
net_sales_attributed.formula: gross_sales − discounts − reversals_attributed (reversals attributed to order week)

net_to_delivered_bridge.label: Not yet delivered, shipping and tax
net_to_delivered_bridge.formula: net_sales_attributed − delivered_revenue: undelivered orders plus pass-through shipping and tax
net_to_delivered_bridge.treatment: Bridges the waterfall's net sales to the delivered basis gross profit is computed on.

new_customer_cac.label: New-customer CAC
new_customer_cac.formula: ad_spend ÷ new-customer orders attributed to the entity
new_customer_cac.treatment: The only CAC that means anything. At week grain it is a ceiling while attribution is partial.

new_vs_returning_cvr_gap.label: Returning − new CVR
new_vs_returning_cvr_gap.formula: cvr_ga4 of returning users − cvr_ga4 of new users

oos_atc_attempts.label: ATC attempts on out-of-stock variants
oos_atc_attempts.formula: add-to-cart attempts on variants with qty_on_hand = 0
oos_atc_attempts.treatment: Capture requirement: the storefront disables add to cart on sold-out variants, so no standard event records the attempt. Needs a custom event.

oos_lost_revenue.label: Revenue lost to stock-outs
oos_lost_revenue.formula: oos sessions × the product's own CVR × AOV

oos_pdp_sessions_ga4.label: Sessions landing on out-of-stock PDPs
oos_pdp_sessions_ga4.formula: GA4 sessions whose landing page is a product with no variant in stock that day

ordered_revenue.label: Ordered revenue
ordered_revenue.formula: Σ total of non-cancelled, non-excluded orders created in the period
ordered_revenue.treatment: A claim on money, not money: COD orders are uncollected until delivered.

orders.label: Orders
orders.formula: non-excluded orders created in the period

organic_direct_orders.label: Organic and direct orders
organic_direct_orders.formula: orders with no paid attribution whose referrer is direct or organic

organic_sessions_ga4.label: Organic sessions
organic_sessions_ga4.formula: GA4 sessions with organic search or organic social channel groups

organic_video_views.label: Organic video views
organic_video_views.treatment: No source connected. Missing until one is.

paid_share_of_revenue.label: Paid share of revenue
paid_share_of_revenue.formula: net sales of paid-attributed orders ÷ net_sales_attributed
paid_share_of_revenue.treatment: A floor, not a total, while attribution_coverage is below 1.

platform_purchases.label: Platform purchases
platform_purchases.treatment: Raw count renders beside every conversion-denominated rate.

platform_revenue.label: Platform revenue
platform_revenue.treatment: Directional. Never summed with Shopify revenue under any aggregation.

platform_roas.label: Platform ROAS
platform_roas.treatment: Never ranks ads at ad level; ranking happens at adset or campaign level, or above a stated minimum-conversion threshold.

post_dispatch_reversal_share.label: Post-dispatch share of reversals
post_dispatch_reversal_share.formula: reversal value cancelled after the first fulfilment ÷ reversal value
post_dispatch_reversal_share.treatment: From fulfilment state at cancellation. Orders with unknown state are left out and reported through coverage.

promoted_close_rate.label: Promoted-product close rate
promoted_close_rate.formula: attributed orders containing the promoted product ÷ attributed orders
promoted_close_rate.treatment: High = closer. Low with high traffic = acquisition engine: it pulls traffic that converts on something else.

purchase_to_delivered_rate.label: Purchase → delivered
purchase_to_delivered_rate.formula: delivered orders ÷ non-excluded orders created in the period
purchase_to_delivered_rate.treatment: Right-censored: in-transit orders count as not delivered until they resolve; coverage states the resolved share.

reason_classified_share.label: Reasons classified
reason_classified_share.formula: reversal value with a reason_code ÷ reversal value
reason_classified_share.treatment: Where the platform's cancel reason carries no signal this is a capture requirement (courier failure reasons or a process change), not a computation.

refund_orders.label: Refunded orders
refund_orders.formula: orders with money returned through either channel, by the order's week
refund_orders.treatment: Two channels, never double-counted: Shopify's own refund amount, and an approved Yanet return, which the courier pays back in cash and Shopify never records. An approved request is treated as money out, because that is when the founder's process releases it; a request still awaiting approval is not.

refund_rate.label: Refund rate
refund_rate.formula: orders with money returned ÷ delivered orders, by the order's week
refund_rate.treatment: Two channels, never double-counted: Shopify's own refund amount, and an approved Yanet return, which the courier pays back in cash and Shopify never records. An approved request is treated as money out, because that is when the founder's process releases it; a request still awaiting approval is not.

refund_units.label: Refunded units
refund_units.formula: Σ units on approved Yanet returns
refund_units.treatment: Two channels, never double-counted: Shopify's own refund amount, and an approved Yanet return, which the courier pays back in cash and Shopify never records. An approved request is treated as money out, because that is when the founder's process releases it; a request still awaiting approval is not. Only the Yanet channel carries lines; a Shopify refund is an amount against the order, so units under-count where that channel is used.

refund_value.label: Refunds
refund_value.formula: Σ Shopify refunded amounts + Σ (goods value − return shipping fee − restocking fee) on approved Yanet returns, by the order's week
refund_value.treatment: The cash the customer actually receives, which is what the courier's remittance is short by. The fees are withheld from the refund, not paid by the business. Two channels, never double-counted: Shopify's own refunds, and approved Yanet returns the courier pays back.

return_cost.label: Return cost
return_cost.formula: refund_value − the cost of the returned goods, which go back on the shelf
return_cost.treatment: What a return leaves behind once the goods are back and sellable: the cash that left, less what those goods cost. Where a returned unit has no cost on file it cannot be credited, and coverage says how much of the return could be.

return_request_rate_units.label: Return request rate (units)
return_request_rate_units.formula: units asked to return ÷ units sold, both by the order's own date
return_request_rate_units.treatment: A request, not a refund: the customer asked, the money may not have moved. Requests arrive 1-9 days after the order (measured over the first export: 94% within 7 days), so a week is only fully readable 14 days after it ends; coverage states the settled share. Orders placed before the first uploaded request file have no request data at all and read missing, never 0.

return_requests_units.label: Units asked to return
return_requests_units.formula: units on Yanet return requests, counted against the week the order was placed
return_requests_units.treatment: Requests arrive 1-9 days after the order (measured over the first export: 94% within 7 days), so a week is only fully readable 14 days after it ends; coverage states the settled share. Orders placed before the first uploaded request file have no request data at all and read missing, never 0.

reversal_rate.label: Reversal rate
reversal_rate.formula: reversed orders ÷ orders, by order week
reversal_rate.treatment: Cancellations are RTO. Right-censored: recent weeks rise as late cancellations arrive; coverage states the resolved share.

reversal_rate_units.label: Reversal rate (units)
reversal_rate_units.formula: reversed units from cancelled orders' line items ÷ units ordered
reversal_rate_units.treatment: From line items, not courier outcomes, which miss cancellations that never shipped. Never merged with genuine returns.

reversals_attributed.label: Reversals (order week)
reversals_attributed.treatment: Right-censored: recent order weeks gain reversals as late cancellations arrive; coverage states the resolved share.

reversals_booked.label: Reversals (as booked)
reversals_booked.formula: Σ fact_reversal.value by cancel_week — cancellations, which are RTO
reversals_booked.treatment: Booked on the cancel date. Shown only beside the attributed figure; weekly economics use reversals_attributed.

rto_cost_total.label: RTO cost
rto_cost_total.formula: ad spend attributed to reversed orders + outbound leg + return leg

rto_rate_cod.label: Reversal rate, COD
rto_rate_cod.formula: reversed COD orders ÷ COD orders, by order week

rto_rate_prepaid.label: Reversal rate, prepaid
rto_rate_prepaid.formula: reversed prepaid orders ÷ prepaid orders, by order week

rto_shipping_waste.label: RTO shipping waste
rto_shipping_waste.formula: (outbound leg + return leg) on reversed orders that had dispatched

rto_units.label: RTO units
rto_units.formula: Σ units on reversed orders, by order week

search_sessions_shopify.label: Search sessions
search_sessions_shopify.formula: Σ Shopify sessions whose referrer bucket is search
search_sessions_shopify.treatment: Shopify's own referrer bucket, not a GA4 channel group. `social` counts paid and organic social together, so it is traffic from social, not organic demand on its own.

social_sessions_shopify.label: Social sessions
social_sessions_shopify.formula: Σ Shopify sessions whose referrer bucket is social
social_sessions_shopify.treatment: Shopify's own referrer bucket, not a GA4 channel group. `social` counts paid and organic social together, so it is traffic from social, not organic demand on its own. It rises with ad spend, so it is not a demand signal on its own — read it against direct and search.

spend_pace.label: Spend pace
spend_pace.formula: ad spend since drop_date ÷ planned drop-window budget (dim_drop.planned_ad_budget)

time_to_exchange.label: Time to exchange
time_to_exchange.formula: median days from requested_at to completed_at

time_to_return.label: Time to return
time_to_return.formula: median days from delivered_at to refund created_at

training_effect_gap.label: Training effect
training_effect_gap.formula: full_price_repeat_rate of customers acquired inside offer windows − outside them
training_effect_gap.treatment: The measurable cost of a discounting regime, tracked by acquisition_offer_id.

unattributed_session_share_ga4.label: Unattributed sessions (GA4)
unattributed_session_share_ga4.formula: GA4 sessions with source (not set) or channel Unassigned ÷ GA4 sessions

units_total.label: Units
units_total.formula: Σ units on non-excluded orders created in the period

unpaid_session_share_shopify.label: Non-social session share
unpaid_session_share_shopify.treatment: How much of the week's traffic did not come through social. A proxy for demand that does not depend on spend, and a crude one: paid traffic that loses its referrer lands in direct.
